US indicts Indian gangsters for Nijjar murder, straining Canada-India ties

The United States has indicted jailed Indian gangster Lawrence Bishnoi and others for their alleged involvement in a conspiracy to murder Khalistani separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Canada. The charges have led to significant international attention and appear to have strained relations between India and Canada. The US Department of Justice has stated that no Indian government officials were involved in the killing.
